source: docs/product/ai-layer-2026-10.md section 5 (weights copied verbatim); planning inputs, not a tariff contract.

creditUnit.description: 1 credit = 0.10 RUB of p95 cost. An internal cost-weighted unit: the user sees percentages and approximate counts, never credits as money.

revisionPolicy: Weights are revised after 14 days of measurements. A revision publishes a new rateCardVersion; it never applies retroactively to ledger entries or reservations that already carry rc-v1.

pricingKinds.CREDITS: Debited from the credit bar at the listed weight.
pricingKinds.FAIR_USE: Not debited from the bar; counted in a separate bucket with per-month and per-day limits (allowances-v1.json).

capBuckets.qualityImages: Count cap on quality generated images
capBuckets.highFactcheck: Count cap on high-effort fact checks
capBuckets.smartPlan: Count cap on smart plans (Flash and Pro share it; the Max plan's four Pro plans are counted in the same bucket)
capBuckets.stt: Fair-use bucket of speech-to-text, metered in seconds, shown as whole minutes rounded up
capBuckets.assessment: Fair-use bucket of AI answer checks, counted in answers

availability.LATER: Planned after the first paid launch (image generation).

operations.name: Five exercises for one material
operations.note: Pro-rated per exercise: ceil(8 x n / 5) for n exercises.

operations.name: Edit by selection or chat turn
One minute of speech-to-text
operations.note: Cost range is the external API case; self-host is a fixed cost. Metered in seconds; shown as whole minutes rounded up.

operations.name: Text-to-speech clip of 30 seconds (about 400 characters)
operations.note: 0 credits on a cache hit: credits are charged only on a cache miss.

estimation.p95: The sum of the rate card weights of the operations the spec implies (the worst case). The reservation holds p95.
estimation.p50: The same formula with typical (median) weights, defined as the rate card weight x 0.6 per operation, rounded up once on the sum, until measured weights exist (rc-v1 note: the 0.6 factor is a placeholder to be replaced by the 14-day measurements). There is no first-two-misses and rest-hits language: the rate card holds worst-case weights only.
estimation.exercisesProRata: EXERCISES_PER_MATERIAL is priced per exercise: ceil(8 x n / 5) for n exercises.
estimation.mediaCounts: The estimate prices only the media counts declared in the spec; the MBM compiler rejects excess directives (at most 8 per artifact), so the reservation cannot be exceeded by the document.
estimation.rounding: Credits are integers; percentages are rounded half up.

actionOperations.description: Edit action to rate card operation (each chargeable action reserves it at admission).
actionOperations.notes: REMOVE_MEDIA is free and needs no reservation. IMAGE_GENERATE uses the quality weight (IMAGE_GENERATE_QUALITY) when the spec asks for quality; generation is availability LATER. A media redo in a slot (find similar, create, regenerate audio) maps like the action.
